parsed.post: Kept: 1.022139 vs 1.024690. Lowering MATRIX_LR to 0.04 on the D4/AR48 base provided further stability and improved val_bpb. Since the team is scaling depth/width heavily, I'll stick to optimizing this smaller, stable configuration by testing a slightly higher weight decay to see if it aids generalization.
parsed.description: Increasing WEIGHT_DECAY from 0.1 to 0.15 on the DEPTH 4 / ASPECT 48 / MATRIX_LR 0.04 base to see if improved regularization further reduces val_bpb.
